"""Audit the real row5000 checkpoint and four complete fresh-noise passes."""
import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
import torch
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from v175_postprocess import REPO,ROOT,context,read,ref,source,write_once
from v175_training_trace_audit import validate_trace

from demosaic.late_local_noise_matching import LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail

plan,post=context()
out=REPO/'docs/results/v175-four-pass-boundary-audit-v1.json'
assert not out.exists()
owner=read(ROOT/'train-launch-v1.json')['owner'];process=psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
assert process.create_time()==owner['created'] and process.status() not in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE,psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
raw=(ROOT/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').read_bytes();complete=raw[:raw.rfind(b'\n')+1].splitlines(keepends=True)
assert len(complete)>=4001
prefix=b''.join(complete[:4000]);trace=[json.loads(line) for line in complete[:4000]]
event_raw=(ROOT/'train-forward-events-v1.jsonl').read_bytes()
event_prefix=b''.join(line for line in event_raw[:event_raw.rfind(b'\n')+1].splitlines(keepends=True) if json.loads(line)['step']<=5000)
events=[json.loads(line) for line in event_prefix.splitlines()]
cache=read(plan['cache']['path'])['batches'];units=read(plan['pair_units']['path'])['rows']
eligible=read(plan['clean_sensor_preflight']['path'])['rows'];old=read(plan['initial_training']['path'])['trace']
audit=validate_trace(trace,cache,units,eligible,old,events,plan)
assert len(trace)==4000 and trace[-1]['step']==5000
assert audit['updates']==3600 and audit['skips']==400 and audit['fresh']==3588 and audit['cached']==12
assert audit['counts']=={'wrapper':3600,'frozen':3600,'network':3600,'sampler':18000}
assert audit['parent_counts']=={'parent':3590,'DINO':3590}
assert audit['totals']==3600 and audit['maximum_difference']==0
visits=[json.loads(complete[i]) for i in [0,1000,2000,3000,4000]]
assert all(row['cache_step']==1 and row['original_batch']==visits[0]['original_batch'] for row in visits)
assert len({row['sensor_draw']['seed'] for row in visits})==5
for key in ['packed','variance']:
 assert len({row['inputs'][key]['sha256'] for row in visits})==5
for key in visits[0]['inputs']:
 if key not in ['packed','variance']:assert all(row['inputs'][key]==visits[0]['inputs'][key] for row in visits)
assert len({row['parent_values']['sha256'] for row in visits})==5
binding=ref(Path(plan['external'])/'checkpoints/step05000.pt')
checkpoint=torch.load(binding['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
initial=torch.load(plan['initial_checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
assert checkpoint['step']==5000 and checkpoint['updates']==3600 and checkpoint['total_updates']==4500
assert checkpoint['skipped']==400 and checkpoint['counts']==audit['counts'] and checkpoint['parent_counts']==audit['parent_counts']
assert len(checkpoint['optimizer']['state'])==141
assert all(float(state['step'])==4500 and all(torch.isfinite(value).all() for value in state.values()) for state in checkpoint['optimizer']['state'].values())
frozen=[name for name in checkpoint['models'] if name.startswith('frozen.')]
assert len(frozen)==47 and all(torch.equal(checkpoint['models'][name],initial['models'][name]) for name in frozen)
module=LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**plan['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(checkpoint['models'],strict=True)
raw_hash=model_hash(module);module.network.load_state_dict(checkpoint['ema'],strict=True);EMA_hash=model_hash(module)
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
watch_owner=read(ROOT/'completion-watch-launch-v1.json')['owner'];watch=psutil.Process(watch_owner['pid'])
assert watch.create_time()==watch_owner['created'] and watch.status() not in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE,psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
assert psutil.Process(owner['pid']).create_time()==owner['created']
assert not (ROOT/'train-failure-v1.json').exists() and not (ROOT/'review-launch-v1.json').exists()
write_once(out,{
 'status':'pass-real-row5000-checkpoint-four-complete-passes-and-distinct-fifth-visit',
 'observed_unix_UTC':time.time(),'training_owner':owner,'training_owner_live':True,'completion_watcher_owner':watch_owner,'watcher_live':True,
 'plan':ref(ROOT/'plan-v1.json'),'checkpoint':binding,'checkpoint_new_updates':3600,'checkpoint_total_optimizer_updates':4500,
 'actual_Adam_states':141,'actual_Adam_step':4500,'frozen47_state_tensors_exact_initial':True,
 'raw_module_hash':raw_hash,'EMA_module_hash':EMA_hash,'complete_continuation_rows_checked':4000,'ADC_skips_checked':400,
 'fresh_sensor_batches_checked':3588,'retained_cached_noisy_batches_checked':12,
 'matching_counts':audit['counts'],'parent_DINO_counts_including_two_original_replays':audit['parent_counts'],
 'FP32_loss_totals_checked':audit['totals'],'maximum_loss_total_difference':audit['maximum_difference'],
 'inherited_clean_masks_checked':audit['masks'],'parent_argument_fingerprints_checked':audit['observed_arguments'],
 'durable_forward_events_checked':len(events),'unique_fresh_sensor_seeds':len(audit['seeds']),
 'five_visits_same_scene_target_calibration_pairs':True,'five_actual_RAW_variance_parent_fingerprints_distinct':True,
 'visits':[{'continuation_row':row['continuation_row'],'total_row':row['step'],'seed':row['sensor_draw']['seed'],
            'RAW':row['inputs']['packed'],'variance':row['inputs']['variance'],'parent_values':row['parent_values']} for row in visits],
 'journal_prefix':{'path':str(ROOT/'train-trace-v1.jsonl'),'bytes':len(prefix),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(prefix).hexdigest()},
 'event_journal_prefix':{'path':str(ROOT/'train-forward-events-v1.jsonl'),'bytes':len(event_prefix),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(event_prefix).hexdigest()},
 'fifth_visit_journal_line':{'line':4001,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(complete[4000]).hexdigest()},
 'new_neural_forwards':0,'new_sensor_noise_draws':0,'CUDA_initialized':False,'source':source(__file__),
 'scope':'Real completed checkpoint/prefix audit while original training continues,not final training or performance. The4000 rows/events and3600loss totals use the already exercised final validator. Raw/EMA strict CPU loads and all141Adam clocks checked. Five same-scene visits have actual distinct noisy/variance/parent fingerprints;later full arrays were streamed,not independently regenerated or retained. Seven saved first-prefix batches were audited separately. No new noise,parent/DINO,sampler or model forward. Prefix byte hashes remain valid after later appends;owner liveness is timestamp-specific.'})
print('PASS4000rows3600updates3588fresh141Adam4500;frozen47exact;noinference/noise',flush=True)
